meta.name: story-deslop
meta.description: 网文去AI味。检测并清除文本中的AI写作痕迹，让文字回归自然、非模板化。触发方式：/story-deslop、/去AI味、「去AI味」「这篇太AI了」「网文去AI味」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 去除文本中的AI痕迹，让网文更自然
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写网文，希望文字不显模板化
copy.tagline_en: Remove AI traces from text to make web novels more natural
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want to remove AI-generated feel

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会检测并清除网文中的 AI 写作痕迹，如禁用词、工整句式、心理描写等，改为自然口语，保留剧情。
howto.when: 当您说“去AI味”“这篇太AI了”或使用命令 /story-deslop 时触发。

say.note: Claude 会扫描并返回问题标记。

say.text: 这段写得太AI了，帮我润色。
say.note: Claude 会执行完整去AI流程并输出修改。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will detect and remove AI writing traces in web novels, such as banned words, rigid sentence patterns, psychological descriptions, etc., rewriting them into natural colloquial language while preserving the plot.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "去AI味" or "这篇太AI了", or use the command /story-deslop.

say_en.text: Check if this passage has AI flavor.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and return issue markers.

say_en.text: This passage is too AI-like, polish it.
say_en.note: Claude will run full de-AI process and output modifications.

say_en.text: Remove AI flavor from this text.
say_en.note: Claude will directly rewrite the text.
